rules.acceptance_criteria: Every recorded transition must declare L, Q, O*, admissibility status, and transition validity.
rules.failure_criteria: Missing operator trace fields or untyped transition records.

rules.acceptance_criteria: Every minimizer switch must classify switch mode and boundedness.
rules.failure_criteria: Switches recorded without mismatch-cost delta or stability classification.

rules.acceptance_criteria: Ref(.) equivalence transitions must declare whether equivalence was preserved and report d_Omega.
rules.failure_criteria: Reference transition lacks equivalence or pseudometric information.

rules.acceptance_criteria: Every recoupling event must cite residue context and admissibility-window change or valid recoupling rule.
rules.failure_criteria: Recoupling event is memoryless or lacks residue/admissibility context.

rules.acceptance_criteria: All required falsification vectors must be executed and classified.
rules.failure_criteria: Missing required falsification vector or unclassified falsification result.

rules.acceptance_criteria: All outputs must be recoverable and tied to tool certification, source commit, and config hash.
rules.failure_criteria: Missing provenance, unrecoverable outputs, or uncertified tool reference.
